countries.risk_factors: Smoking history, obesity, post-menopausal hormonal factors
countries.clinical_insight: NHS centralized screening and fast-track 2-week cancer referral pathway prioritize early diagnostic triage across population centers.

countries.risk_factors: Hepatitis B endemic background, smoking, indoor/outdoor particulate matter
countries.clinical_insight: Accounts for >24% of global cancer mortality; dramatic recent reductions in stomach/liver cancer driven by HBV vaccination and H. pylori eradication.

countries.risk_factors: High proportion of elderly population, historical tobacco exposure
countries.clinical_insight: Universal healthcare access and strict clinical guideline adherence keep age-standardized mortality low despite high absolute numbers.

countries.risk_factors: Historical tobacco peak, obesity & metabolic syndrome
countries.clinical_insight: Age-standardized mortality has dropped >30% since 1991 due to smoking cessation, low-dose CT screening, and precision immunotherapy access.

countries.risk_factors: High UV solar radiation index (Melanoma), aging population
countries.clinical_insight: Pioneer in population-level HPV vaccination, projected to become the first nation to eliminate cervical cancer by 2035.
countries.screening_coverage: Very High (National Bowel, Breast & Cervical Screening Programs)

countries.risk_factors: Urbanization, dietary transition, regional healthcare disparities
countries.clinical_insight: Significant geographic disparity between developed Southeast centers (São Paulo) and underserved North/Northeast states.

countries.risk_factors: Super-aged demographic (>29% age 65+), dietary salt intake
countries.clinical_insight: World leader in 5-year stomach cancer survival (>65%) due to mandatory nationwide endoscopic screening and early mucosal dissection.

countries.risk_factors: High adult male smoking prevalence (~65%), HPV vaccination rollout
countries.clinical_insight: Standardized mortality is 19.4% below global average due to younger demographic pyramid, but diagnostic delay in secondary/tertiary facilities leads to late-stage presentation.

countries.risk_factors: Westernized dietary patterns, sedentary urban lifestyle, low parity
countries.clinical_insight: High 5-year survival rates on par with top OECD nations backed by universal health savings and tertiary oncology infrastructure.
countries.screening_coverage: Very High (Screen for Life national subsidies)

countries.risk_factors: Smokeless tobacco (gutka/khaini), betel quid chewing, HPV prevalence
countries.clinical_insight: Highest global burden of oral/lip cancers; standardized rate is comparatively lower due to younger age distribution, but fatality per case remains high.
countries.screening_coverage: Emerging (Community health worker visual oral & cervical screening)

survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Even with metastatic dissemination, curative intent remains achievable in >70% of advanced cases.

survival_matrix.primary_factor: Indolent growth kinetics of papillary & follicular variants
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Radioiodine ablation and surgical thyroidectomy yield near-normal life expectancy for localized subtypes.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Serum PSA testing, Digital Rectal Exam, mpMRI
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Androgen deprivation therapy responsiveness and slow doubling time
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Active surveillance is viable for low-risk Gleason scores without immediate radical intervention.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Dermatoscopic ABCDE criteria inspection & optical biopsy
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Breslow thickness at excision; high immunogenicity (anti-PD-1)
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Excision at Breslow depth <1mm confers >95% cure rate, while checkpoint inhibitors revolutionized metastatic care.

survival_matrix.primary_factor: Molecular subtyping (ER/PR/HER2) and targeted monoclonal antibodies
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Early detection prior to axillary lymph node involvement elevates 5-year survival beyond 98%.

survival_matrix.early_detection: High-risk HPV DNA co-testing & liquid-based cytology
survival_matrix.primary_factor: HPV viral etiology makes it almost entirely preventable with vaccination
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Ablation of pre-cancerous CIN lesions stops progression into invasive squamous cell carcinoma.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Screening colonoscopy (with polypectomy) & FIT stool tests
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Adenoma-to-carcinoma sequence spans 10-15 years, providing wide window
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Endoscopic polypectomy prevents malignant transformation, halving long-term mortality.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Excisional lymph node biopsy & PET-CT staging
survival_matrix.primary_factor: B-cell vs T-cell lineage and R-CHOP immunochemotherapy
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is curable in ~60-70% with standard anti-CD20 regimens.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Peripheral blood smear & bone marrow aspiration/cytogenetics
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Subtype stratification (ALL, AML, CLL, CML) & tyrosine kinase inhibitors
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: CML transformed from fatal to manageable chronic condition with targeted BCR-ABL TKIs (imatinib).

survival_matrix.primary_factor: Often asymptomatic until late mucosal invasion; H. pylori eradication
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Japan achieves >65% survival through population-level endoscopy, whereas Western late diagnosis yields <30%.

survival_matrix.primary_factor: Blood-brain barrier restricts systemic delivery; infiltrative nature
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Glioblastoma (Grade IV) median survival remains 14-16 months despite maximal surgical resection and radiation.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Upper endoscopy for chronic Barrett's esophagus surveillance
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Lack of serosal barrier permits rapid mediastinal lymphatic invasion
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Trimodal therapy (neoadjuvant chemoradiation + esophagectomy) is required for locoregional cure.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Annual Low-Dose Computed Tomography (LDCT) in high-risk smokers
survival_matrix.primary_factor: 70%+ cases diagnosed at stage III/IV due to asymptomatic lung parenchyma
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: LDCT screening shifts stage distribution to Stage I, increasing 5-year survival by over 4-fold.

survival_matrix.early_detection: Abdominal ultrasound + serum Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP) every 6 months
survival_matrix.primary_factor: Co-existing cirrhosis/hepatitis limits hepatic functional reserve for surgery
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Early surveillance enables curative ablation or liver transplantation before portal vein thrombosis.

survival_matrix.primary_factor: Dense desmoplastic stroma impairs chemotherapy drug perfusion
survival_matrix.clinical_takeaway: Only 15-20% of patients present with surgically resectable tumors at initial symptomatic presentation.

income_tiers.countries_sample: United States, Germany, Japan, United Kingdom, Australia
income_tiers.insight: High crude rate is driven by demographic aging (>18.5% over 65). However, age-standardized mortality is the lowest and falling steadily due to early screening, targeted biologics, and tobacco reduction.

income_tiers.countries_sample: China, Brazil, Russia, Bulgaria, Serbia, Turkey
income_tiers.insight: Highest age-standardized mortality globally. Driven by peak historical tobacco/alcohol consumption and expanding industrialization before complete nationwide screening saturation.

income_tiers.healthcare_access: Emerging Public Insurance (e.g. BPJS, Ayushman Bharat)
income_tiers.insight: Younger population pyramid buffers crude rates. High proportion of preventable infection-linked malignancies (HPV, HBV); expanding universal healthcare is accelerating diagnostic capacity.

income_tiers.countries_sample: Afghanistan, Uganda, Mali, Chad, DR Congo
income_tiers.insight: Substantial diagnostic underreporting and competing infectious mortality mask true burden. Lack of radiotherapy and late stage IV presentation result in extremely low 5-year survival.
